title: Evia Pulse freeze fix
details: Fixed a v235 Review History rendering loop that could freeze Evia when Pulse was opened
Pulse Review History now updates only after relevant user actions or a new review snapshot instead of continuously watching and rewriting the page
Existing review snapshots, wellbeing history, confidence history, targets and Milos review data are unchanged
The v235 permanent Review Snapshot feature remains available inside Evia Pulse
summary: Evia v236 fixes the Pulse lock-up introduced in v235 by removing the self-triggering Review History DOM observer while preserving all Pulse and review data.
changes: Keep Review History without continuous DOM rewrites
